causes.what: Interface errors surged on dist-sw-01, the upstream switch for web-01..04 (and hv-02). This causes packet loss to the whole web tier, slow HTTP responses, and 5xx at the load balancer.

ruled_out: app/db tier (app-01 db errors 0, db-01 cpu 21%, io wait 6%, normal)
lb-01 itself (cpu 19%, all 4 backends still healthy; its 5xx is a symptom)
evidence: dist-sw-01 if.errors.rate jumped from ~0.1-0.9 to ~33 at 05:34:26 and stays at 27-35 through 05:39
web-01..04 icmp loss went from 0% to 8-14% at about 05:35, and hv-02 (also behind dist-sw-01) shows 9.6% loss
the four web-tier alerts and the lb-01 alert all fired 05:35:24-05:35:45, just after the errors began
every host behind dist-sw-01 is affected, and the hosts behind dist-sw-02 and core-rtr-01 are clean
dist-sw-01 uplink status is still up (1), so this looks like a degraded link or port (errors) and not a down link
